google_news_access: Use the documented public-page headline view through permitted editorial browsing. No RSS/API adapter is asserted. Record region, language and observed section; personalized placement is not general headline placement.

channels.name: MIT News AI
channels.editorial_use: Institutional research reporting; verify linked paper, author, event date and limitations.
channels.reuse_license_status: Web republication has attribution conditions; translation permission was not explicit. The image-only CC BY-NC-ND rule must not be applied to article text.

channels.name: Berkeley AI Research Blog
channels.editorial_use: Researcher-written explanations; occasional publication, not a daily freshness guarantee.
channels.reuse_license_status: Authors retain copyright. The blog explicitly asks would-be translators to contact authors. No request was sent.

channels.name: ACL Anthology
channels.editorial_use: NLP papers and proceedings; preserve paper identifier and actual first-publication/version dates.
channels.reuse_license_status: Site states ACL material from 2016 onward uses CC BY 4.0; older material uses CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Confirm the exact paper and third-party exclusions.

channels.name: arXiv cs.LG
channels.editorial_use: Expand beyond cs.AI; deduplicate cross-listed paper IDs and record version changes. Preprints are not peer-review certification.
channels.reuse_license_status: Each paper/version has its own license. arXiv hosting or a default nonexclusive license does not grant full-translation rights.

channels.name: arXiv cs.CL
channels.editorial_use: NLP and multilingual research; share deduplication with cs.AI/cs.LG.
channels.reuse_license_status: Each paper/version has its own license; inspect it before translation.

channels.name: PyTorch Blog
channels.editorial_use: Open-source implementation and release explanations. Separate author benchmarks, case studies and press releases. Confirm exact version/release state.
channels.reuse_license_status: Software licenses do not automatically cover the blog text; article-level reuse permission unverified.

channels.name: Ars Technica
channels.editorial_use: Independent reporting for discovery and context; verify technical claims with primary sources.
channels.reuse_license_status: The page reserves reproduction rights; no full-translation permission verified.

channels.name: iThome
channels.editorial_use: Traditional Chinese enterprise, security and local adoption reporting. Distinguish newsroom stories from sponsored/industry posts and community blogs.
channels.reuse_license_status: No article-level translation license verified; do not infer one from public access.

channels.name: 中央通訊社科技
channels.editorial_use: Taiwan/Asia reporting; retain byline and origin. FeedBurner delivery and final article host need separate validation.
channels.reuse_license_status: RSS terms restrict use to personal/nonprofit noncommercial purposes with credit and byline; the feed is not a full-text reuse license.

channels.name: AI Singapore News
channels.editorial_use: Regional language and deployment perspectives. Latest observed listing was July 2026; use only when a genuinely fresh event exists.
channels.reuse_license_status: No article-text adaptation license verified; tool/software licenses do not establish article rights.

channels.name: Google News Taiwan / 繁中
channels.editorial_use: Discover important AI-related events, then attribute and verify the original publisher. The aggregator does not count as an additional independent reporting outlet.
channels.reuse_license_status: Discovery does not establish rights to the original publisher article.

channels.name: Google News English / US edition
channels.region: US (global AI coverage sought; not an all-world ranking)
channels.editorial_use: Discover important AI-related events, then attribute and verify the original publisher. The aggregator does not count as an additional independent reporting outlet.
channels.reuse_license_status: Discovery does not establish rights to the original publisher article.

channels.name: Martin Fowler / authored and edited engineering articles
channels.editorial_use: AI software design, development practices and architecture; preserve each article byline because the site includes guest authors.
channels.reuse_license_status: Author FAQ allows online translations with an original-article link. Confirm exact authorship and article exceptions; this is not blanket authority over guest writing.

channels.name: Kent Beck / Software Design: Tidy First?
channels.editorial_use: AI and software-design practice, TDD and developer experience. Distinguish an argued perspective from a measured result.
channels.reuse_license_status: Copyright notice observed; no blanket translation permission verified. Use only readable public text, not unseen paid content.

channels.name: Charity Majors / charity.wtf
channels.editorial_use: Operational engineering, observability and AI-assisted software delivery, when a specific dated public post supports it.

channels.name: Andrej Karpathy / writing and talks
channels.editorial_use: AI tools, programming workflows and technical explanations. Use the blog/channel linked from his own site; confirm each post or talk date.
channels.reuse_license_status: No blog or talk translation license verified; model/code licenses do not license narrative or video.

channels.name: Paul Graham / essays
channels.editorial_use: Software, AI and building technology companies when an essay is relevant; the name alone is not a selection reason.
channels.reuse_license_status: Official FAQ permits online translations, asks for the original link and for the translation URL to be sent to the author. No contact was made.

channels.name: Simon Willison and linked authors
channels.editorial_use: The existing collector feed mixes original writing, links and quotes; retain the actual byline and classify the work before selection.
channels.reuse_license_status: Check the individual work; feed visibility does not grant whole-translation rights.

selection_rules: Verify the original publisher, byline, body and publication/event time before selecting.
Use a rolling 48-hour window. A repost or aggregator appearance does not reset the original publication time.
Deduplicate original article URLs and verified event keys against published history; syndication is not independent corroboration.
Use AI/topic relevance and source evidence for the two featured positions; never invent popularity scores or an observed rank.
Preserve author opinions as attributed views, not established facts or assistant advice.
Check rights per work; public access, RSS, software licenses and aggregator inclusion do not grant blanket translation permission.
If a required channel cannot be checked, disclose incomplete coverage rather than report successful empty results.
